risks.risk: Console model and storage are unconfirmed; a slim or base PS4 or a different storage size changes the price.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear or underside label showing the CUH model number and serial, plus a screen photo of Settings > System > System Information.
risks.if_unproven: Not priced until the model is read.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, may have HDMI port damage, overheating or a failed drive.
risks.proof: Continuous clip: power on, boot to home screen, launch a game, show the HDMI port close up.

risks.risk: Console may be account-locked, banned from PSN or have a serial mismatch with the box.
risks.proof: Screen photo of the console signed out with System Information serial matching the rear label.

risks.risk: Third-party controllers may be the only pads; no original DualShock included.
risks.proof: Photo of all included controllers out of the box, paired and working on screen.

risks.risk: Photo may be a dealer stock image rather than the unit being sold.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the unit beside a handwritten note with today's date and the seller's name.
risks.if_unproven: Hold the deal until the live photo arrives.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's rear or underside label showing the CUH model number and serial.
Screen photo of Settings > System > System Information showing model, storage and system software.
Clip powering the console on and playing a game, with the controller in hand.
Photo of the unit beside a handwritten note with today's date.
Close-up of the HDMI and USB ports.
response.reason: The shape points to a PS4 Pro but no logo, plate or system screen is readable, and the model and storage set the price, so a label or System Information shot is needed before even a worst case price.
